2105-3480-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3480-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3480-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2023-4460-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2292-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

529-4186-6791-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1453-4694-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-5226-7306.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3169-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3169-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

223-3368.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-3368.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-3368.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Reiterate and choosing to copy the original Reiterate.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Reiterate copy, creating a copy of Reiterate.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

3946-5967-7804.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

670-1619-6150-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6150-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Tomb of Horrors Adventurer until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

4499-6091-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Archmage of Runes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve triggers from Archmage of Runes until you have drawn as many cards as desired.
If the remaining number of Archmage of Runes triggers is greater than the number of cards in your library, you must win the game or remove those triggers from the stack at instant speed to avoid losing from drawing from an empty library.

891-2961-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

147-2511-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-4192-5703-7122.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-5170-5933-6132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-1231-2921-6644.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2707-4908-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1575-4231-5270-6311.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1575-4231-5270-6311.description:
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing it and three Foods, causing you to add twelve mana of any color.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure, Food and Clue tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure, Food and Clue tokens.
Resolve the Samwise ability, returning Radiant Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Radiant Lotus by paying {6}.
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing it and an artifact token, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 3.

1750-2793-5261-5315-5740.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Assassin that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-2793-5261-5315-5740.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using an Assassin, triggering Layla Hassan, returning Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2281-5686-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

1170-1328-1753-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-1753-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

2558-4139-5346.description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Resolve the Thopter Foundry ability, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat.

796-2100-2440-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Zombies.
796-2100-2440-5231.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

2043-4131-4365-5295.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Basalt Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Basalt Monolith tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

914-2292-5003.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2292-5003.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2770-4681-5158.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Elesh Norn to an opponent.
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Karmic Guide's enter-the-battleifeld ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1420-2178-4050.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-4050.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Repeat.

1677-2232-2858-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Acolyte of Flame onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+0 Chandra, Acolyte of Flame creating 2 1/1 elementals with haste.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Acolyte of Flame to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1750-2365-4861-5261.description:
Cast Expropriate by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one and exile Expropriate.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Expropriate into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Expropriate from your graveyard by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Expropriate.
Repeat from step 2.
